CNPT.definition_en: Concept or Principle - General manufacturing theories, laws, strategies, or high-level conceptual terms not tied to a specific machine, process step, or parameter.

MFPC.definition_en: Manufacturing Process - Unit manufacturing operations and formally named processes.

MATL.definition_en: Material - Specific materials, alloys, polymers, ceramics, composites, and biomaterials.

PRCP.definition_en: Process Parameter - Adjustable process inputs and setpoints under operator or system control.

PRCH.definition_en: Process Characterization - Characterization techniques, measured descriptors, or outputs used to analyze processes, materials, or parts.

ENTC.definition_en: Enabling Technology - Digital or automation technologies enabling design, control, and integration of manufacturing workflows.

ENGF.definition_en: Engineering Feature - Geometric or engineering features of components or CAD-based design constructs.

MECP.definition_en: Mechanical Property - Mechanical performance properties, metrics, or test-based results.

APP.definition_en: Application - End-use domains, application areas, and product-level manufactured parts.

MEQP.definition_en: Machine or Equipment - Machines, instruments, sensors, and equipment involved in manufacturing.

MFSD.definition_en: Manufacturing Standard - Formal manufacturing standards, specifications, or digital formats.

BIOM.definition_en: Biomedical - Biomedical materials, tissues, or clinically relevant manufactured entities.

final_task_goal:
This corpus builds a multi-label manufacturing NER resource for Technical Language Processing.
 * Document pool and source: English-language abstracts and papers from manufacturing science and engineering literature, covering additive manufacturing, machining, materials, standards, and biomedical applications.
 * Purpose of NER: Identify contiguous spans corresponding to manufacturing-relevant entities and assign them to twelve categories, enabling consistent annotation of materials, processes, parameters, and related concepts.
 * Entity types: Twelve categories—Concept or Principle (CNPT), Manufacturing Process (MFPC), Material (MATL), Process Parameter (PRCP), Process Characterization (PRCH), Enabling Technology (ENTC), Engineering Feature (ENGF), Mechanical Property (MECP), Application (APP), Machine or Equipment (MEQP), Manufacturing Standard (MFSD), and Biomedical (BIOM).
 * Downstream applications: Support ontology-aligned indexing, semantic search, question answering, and construction of manufacturing knowledge graphs, facilitating literature mining and advanced manufacturing informatics.
